name: Where There Are No Angels
source:
It's an ordinary winter day. Pick up your best friend to walk to school together and chat along the way. It's an ordinary winter day, where nothing changes but the forlorn static sky.

[From [url=https://forgottenrainynights.itch.io/wheretherearenoangels]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个平平无奇的冬日。去接上你最好的朋友，一路闲聊着结伴上学吧。这是一个平平无奇的冬日，除了那片凄清而凝滞的天空，什么都不会改变。

[摘自[url=https://forgottenrainynights.itch.io/wheretherearenoangels]itch.io[/url]]
